name: Eat Sleep Cube Repeat 2014
information: This is a three-day residential competition. Please indicate in the comments which option you choose.rnFull weekend residential: 50 euros. This is the recommended option. The price covers overnight accommodation for 2 nights and all meals from breakfast on Saturday to lunch on Sunday. Choose this option if you don't want to miss out on any of the fun! Full weekend non-residential:  25 euros. The price covers all meals as in the residential option. Day competitors Saturday with evening meal: Saturday: 15 euros. Day competitors without evening meal (but with breakfast and lunch): 10 euros per day, Friday free.
